turns.question: What was the average number of customer service calls per day in September 2026, counting days with no calls as zero?
turns.answer: The semantic layer counts 32 calls labelled in September 2026 (1 to 30 September, 30 days) as a period total, a model-derived count of customer calls; it does not return a per-day average, so I cannot give the average with zero-call days counted without computing it myself. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
